beats.say: A scammer is not always on a screen. Sometimes they stand at the door, holding a box.
Do not hold the door for someone without a pass. Politely send them to reception.
A so-called technician may wear a uniform and rush you. Check the visit with IT support yourself.

checkpoint.prompt: An unexpected technician arrives. What do you do?

options.label: He has a uniform, I let him in
options.feedback: Anyone can wear a uniform. Ask IT support about the visit yourself.

options.label: I call IT support myself to check
options.feedback: Right. Check an unexpected visit through the official channel.

beats.say: One habit for every case: stop, check, report. Verify the official way and tell security your doubts.

scenes.title: Technician at the door
scenes.intro: You are at work in the morning. Messages arrive about a visitor who wants to get into the building.

body.text: Hi, I have come to fix your printer and I am at the entrance. I left my pass at home, can you come down and open the door?

steps.say: An unknown technician, and no pass.

actions.label: Coming, I will open it
actions.feedback: Letting someone in without a pass opens the door to anyone. Send them to reception.

actions.label: I call the official IT support number
actions.feedback: Right. Check an unexpected technician's visit yourself through the official channel.

body.text: A technician called Orkhan is at reception and gives your name. No visit is booked. Shall we let him in?

actions.label: Let him in, I called him
actions.feedback: You did not call him. Now a stranger walks freely in the building under your name.

actions.label: He waits at reception until I check
actions.feedback: Right. A visitor registers at reception and is not left alone until checked.

body.text: I called the technician. Take him to the server room yourself. I am in a meeting, do not call.

actions.label: OK, I will take him
actions.feedback: The boss's name and the 'do not call' rule are there to stop you checking. Strangers never enter the server room.

actions.label: I call my boss on the known number
actions.feedback: Great. Always check a boss writing from a new number on the old, known one.

actions.label: Block and report
actions.feedback: Right. Then tell your boss and the security team.

body.text: We have not sent any technician to you today. Good thing you wrote; security is on its way to reception.

actions.label: Thanks, I will tell reception too
actions.feedback: Right. You stopped, checked and reported: all three steps.

actions.label: I will go down and talk to him myself
actions.feedback: Do not confront a suspicious person alone. The security team will handle it.

scenes.prompt: Find the suspicious parts of this email.

body.text: Today at 15:00 technician Orkhan will check the air conditioning in the server room.

spots.label: Outside address
spots.explain: An internal team writes from the organisation's own mail. This address is from another domain.

spots.label: Urgency
spots.explain: Urgency in capital letters pushes you to act without checking.

spots.label: Entry without escort
spots.explain: A visitor is always escorted, especially in the server room.

spots.label: Request to keep it hidden
spots.explain: Asking you to tell no one is meant to stop anyone from checking.

question.prompt: A man with his hands full of boxes wants to follow you in without a pass.

options.label: I hold the door, his hands are full
options.feedback: Being polite is good, but a stranger gets in without any check.

options.label: I politely send him to reception
options.feedback: Correct. Reception will check him and take him to the right person.

options.label: I ask who he is and let him in
options.feedback: You cannot check his answer. Let reception or security decide.

scenes.explain: Following someone in is the simplest physical attack. Everyone uses their own pass, guests go through reception.

body.text: Hi, I came to look at your printer. I left my pass at home, can you come down and open the door?

cards.explain: You should not let in someone without a pass. Send them to reception.

body.text: Mail will be unavailable on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. No action is needed from you.

cards.explain: It asks for no link, password or access. It is just a notice.

body.text: I found a flash drive labelled Salaries 2026 in the hallway. Shall we open it on your computer?

cards.explain: A found flash drive can carry malware. Do not open it, hand it to your security team.

body.text: Your guest Mr Tural has signed in at reception and has a visitor pass. He is waiting for you.

cards.explain: The guest is signed in and waiting. Meet them yourself and escort them.

caption.text: Canteen menu: scan and sign in with your work password

cards.explain: You do not need a work password to see a menu. A QR code like this is there to steal it.

points: Send anyone without a pass to reception
Never plug a found flash drive into a computer
